note: P3-API-07: the message the player sees for every sign-in, LAN, pairing and compatibility error code (the voice outcomes are in voice_feedback.json). Authored text, no clinical value. Codes are the server's `detail` words (routers/pairing.py, routers/device_auth.py, auth/dependencies.py, middleware/lan_pairing.py, lan/compat.py, lan/notices.py: the part before ':') plus the codes the headset makes itself (client_codes). Validated by tools/content/validate_ui_messages.py.

messages.title: Please sign in
messages.message: You are not signed in, or your sign-in has ended.
messages.action: Sign in again from the main menu.

messages.title: Use the website for this
messages.message: This step is done from the ProcSense website, not the headset.
messages.action: Open the website on a computer and sign in there.

messages.title: Waiting for approval
messages.message: The sign-in code has not been approved yet.
messages.action: Enter the code on the website, then wait here.

messages.title: Please wait
messages.message: The headset is checking the code too often.
messages.action: Wait a moment; it will check again by itself.

messages.title: Sign-in refused
messages.message: The sign-in code was refused on the website.
messages.action: Start sign-in again and approve the new code.

messages.title: Code expired
messages.message: The sign-in code has run out of time.
messages.action: Start sign-in again to get a new code.

messages.title: Code not found
messages.message: That code is not known or has run out of time.
messages.action: Check the code on the headset and type it again.

messages.title: Too many tries
messages.message: Too many requests were made in a short time.
messages.action: Wait a minute, then try again.

messages.title: Not found
messages.message: What was asked for does not exist or is not yours.
messages.action: Go back and choose it again.

messages.title: Not allowed
messages.message: Only a platform administrator can do this.
messages.action: Ask the administrator of ProcSense.

messages.title: Account paused
messages.message: Your membership of this organisation has been switched off.
messages.action: Ask your supervisor or the organisation administrator.

messages.title: Not allowed
messages.message: Your role in this organisation cannot do this.
messages.action: Ask a supervisor to do it, or to change your role.

messages.title: Laptop not reachable
messages.message: The headset cannot reach the demonstration laptop.
messages.action: Check that both are on the same Wi-Fi and the laptop server is running. Menu mode still works.

messages.title: No answer in time
messages.message: The laptop did not answer in time.
messages.action: Try again, or carry on with the menu.

messages.title: Laptop is shutting down
messages.message: The laptop server is stopping.
messages.action: Wait until it is started again, then reconnect.

messages.title: Laptop only
messages.message: This can only be done on the laptop itself.
messages.action: Do this step at the laptop.

messages.title: Laptop not set up
messages.message: The laptop server has no database, so results cannot be saved.
messages.action: Run task demo-laptop-check on the laptop and fix what it reports.

messages.title: Pair this headset
messages.message: This headset is not paired with the laptop.
messages.action: Scan the QR code or type the pairing code shown by the laptop.

messages.title: Pairing is off
messages.message: The laptop is not in the demonstration profile, so it does not pair headsets.
messages.action: Start the laptop with task demo-laptop.

messages.title: Wrong pairing code
messages.message: The pairing code does not match the one on the laptop.
messages.action: Check the code on the laptop screen and type it again.

messages.title: Pairing locked for now
messages.message: Too many wrong codes were entered.
messages.action: Wait a few minutes, or restart the laptop server for a new code.

messages.title: Headset not known
messages.message: The laptop does not know this headset any more.
messages.action: Pair the headset again.

messages.title: Demonstration only
messages.message: This works only for the demonstration user on the laptop.
messages.action: Use the demonstration sign-in.

messages.title: Update needed
messages.message: This headset's simulator version does not match the laptop.
messages.action: Install the matching build on the headset or update the laptop.

messages.title: Content does not match
messages.message: The cases on this headset are a different version from the laptop's.
messages.action: Install the matching build on the headset or update the laptop.
